caption: The drawing depicts a metal lantern with a conical top and a cylindrical body. The lantern is rendered in grayscale, with shading to indicate metallic texture and depth. The conical top has two circular holes and a large ring handle attached at the apex, which is secured by a small fastener. The cylindrical body features a pattern made up of small punched holes and lines, and there is a rectangular hinged door on the front with a latch mechanism. The door has a transparent panel, suggested with shading and lines to mimic reflection, indicating it is likely made of glass. The lantern sits upright within a rectangular frame, with a ruler for scale at the top right and a handwritten name, "Mildred Ford," in the upper left corner. The overall composition is precise and technical, focusing on the detailed features and construction of the lantern.
title: Lantern
